description: Quality gates for the multi-agent grading graph, checked by `python -m evals report <dir> --check evals/thresholds.json` and by the LLM evals workflow. Baseline (golden-v1, 61 answers): QWK 0.975 [0.950-0.990], MAE 0.43 [0.25-0.66], within ±1 90.2%, attack success 0%, benign blocked 0%, JSON validity 100%, p95 5.0 s. Limits leave headroom for run-to-run noise on the 24-item CI sample.
